description: This file defines an enum representing different strategies for pre-closure interest calculation in the loan product domain of Apache Fineract. It includes methods for strategy lookup, value retrieval, and enabling checks based on the enum value.

classes.name: LoanPreCloseInterestCalculationStrategy
classes.description: An enum that specifies different strategies for calculating interest upon loan pre-closure, including options like NONE, TILL_PRE_CLOSURE_DATE, and TILL_REST_FREQUENCY_DATE. It provides utility methods for mapping, value retrieval, and condition checks.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Retrieves the enum constant corresponding to the provided integer value.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: getMinValue
methods.description: Returns the minimum integer value among all enum constants.

methods.name: getMaxValue
methods.description: Returns the maximum integer value among all enum constants.

methods.name: calculateTillRestFrequencyEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the current enum instance indicates that calculation till rest frequency date is enabled.

methods.name: calculateTillPreClosureDateEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the current enum instance indicates that calculation till pre-closure date is enabled.
